note: Ratchet, not a cleanup mandate. knownOrphans records what was already unreachable under ratchetRoots when this gate landed; each needs a concrete reason, and an entry that becomes reachable is STALE and must be deleted. New orphans under ratchetRoots fail the build.

knownOrphans.src/systems/signatureAdapters.js: Adapter layer for the unwired site signature model; blocked on the same wiring.
knownOrphans.src/systems/siteSignatureModel.js: Asteroid-site signature model. Same shape as siteThermalModel.js — kernel plus tests, no runtime consumer.
knownOrphans.src/systems/siteThermalModel.js: Asteroid-site thermal model. Pure kernel with tests and no runtime consumer; asteroidSites.js does not import it. Bind it to the site runtime or fold it into that system.
knownOrphans.src/systems/titles.js: Depth S4 (Authority + Thunderchild) cross-faction title reducer. Its own header states no consumer is required; 02_REMAINING_WORK S4 still lists the morale/decal/news consumers as outstanding. Wire it through those consumers or retire it — do not add more producers.
knownOrphans.src/ui/dockArrival.js: Dock-arrival presentation helper with no importer; the arrival beat is currently owned by uiRoot/stationHub.
knownOrphans.src/ui/panels/handlingProfile.js: BP-09 fitting readout, same wiring gap as moduleRisk.js.
knownOrphans.src/ui/panels/massDelta.js: BP-09 fitting readout, same wiring gap as moduleRisk.js.
knownOrphans.src/ui/panels/moduleRisk.js: BP-09.1 module-drawback glyphs. A readout helper for the fitting screens that no fitting screen imports; depends on S3-F5 truthful previews landing first.
